## 3. Technical Crawler & GEO Standards

### 3.1 AI Search Crawlers to Allow (Never Block)
- `OAI-SearchBot` (OpenAI live search engine)
- `ChatGPT-User` (ChatGPT user live browsing)
- `PerplexityBot` (Perplexity search indexer)
- `Perplexity-User` (Perplexity live retriever)
- `Claude-SearchBot` (Anthropic search indexer)
- `Claude-User` (Anthropic live citation engine)
- `Googlebot` (Powers Google Search and Google AI Overviews)
- `Bingbot` (Powers Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT live search queries)
